organizations.name: Canada Rocket Company
organizations.description: Canada Rocket Company is a Toronto launch-vehicle and propulsion developer. Its current website centres on a reusable R-2 design with nine E-1 methalox engines and a target above 12,500 kg to sun-synchronous orbit. Earlier reporting described seven engines; the public revision date is unspecified. National Defence separately funds its R1 development project. The architecture remains a development proposition rather than an operational launch service.

capabilities.name: R-series launch vehicles and E-1 methalox engine
capabilities.summary: CRC’s current R-2 design uses nine E-1 methalox engines and targets more than 12,500 kg to sun-synchronous orbit. Earlier IEEE reporting described seven engines and a 12,000–15,000 kg LEO target. These differently scoped design claims require a dated configuration baseline; neither establishes flown performance.
capabilities.capability_type: Development-stage orbital launch vehicles and methalox propulsion
defence_applications: Defence, civil and commercial satellite deployment
capabilities.maturity: Development-stage. IEEE reported a fully assembled engine static-fire expectation in late 2027 and orbital testing years away. The current website’s nine-engine configuration is undated and is not evidence of completed engine or flight qualification.
capabilities.commercial_availability: A launch-development offering; no operational service or accepted payload flight is established by the inspected company and government evidence.

organizations.name: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation
organizations.description: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation is a Waterloo-based Canadian space and defence technology company developing dual-use systems for strategic power, remote and Arctic operations, space resources, water purification and advanced sensing.

capabilities.name: POLAR-1 Terrestrial Microreactor
capabilities.summary: CSMC is developing POLAR-1 to supply continuous electricity and heat to northern, Indigenous, industrial and defence sites. Its proposed transportability and remote monitoring address the logistics of off-grid power. Exact electrical and thermal ratings, transport mass and service intervals are not specified in the launch materials.
core_features: Megawatt-scale power concept combining electricity and useful heat
Designed for military-aircraft transport, including the C-17
Remote monitoring and long service intervals are design goals
defence_applications: Northern and off-grid electricity and heat
capabilities.maturity: Company target: first criticality by 2028. The CEO describes a criticality experiment and safety-system validation rather than a completed power plant; no demonstrated TRL is assigned.
capabilities.commercial_availability: Company target for fleet deployments beginning in 2030; this is not an operating fleet or a delivery commitment.

capabilities.name: JAY-1 Space Reactor
capabilities.summary: CSMC is developing JAY-1 for sustained power on the Moon and future space infrastructure. The concept targets compact integration with lunar landers and autonomous operation for habitats, scientific facilities and resource activities. These are intended functions rather than flight-qualified performance.
core_features: Intended compact integration with lunar landers
Autonomous operation and long-duration surface power are design goals
capabilities.maturity: Introduced in September 2026 as a space reactor concept. No flight qualification, completed deployment or platform-specific TRL is established by the inspected launch materials.

capabilities.name: LunaPure Lunar Water Purification
capabilities.summary: LunaPure is a self-contained, low-maintenance lunar-water purification concept. The Canadian Space Agency selected CSMC as its Aqualunar Challenge grand-prize winner in April 2026 and awarded further development support; the competition result does not establish lunar deployment.
defence_applications: Water purification for sustained lunar exploration
capabilities.maturity: CSA announced the Aqualunar grand-prize selection on April 15, 2026 and $400,000 for continued LunaPure development after a three-stage competition. This establishes an evaluated development concept, not a lunar mission or commercial qualification.

capabilities.name: HYDRO+ Lunar Resource Processing
capabilities.summary: HYDRO+ is CSMC's lunar resource-processing concept for varied ores and geological regions. The Canadian Space Agency funded a prototype in 2023; CSMC continues to position resource processing within its lunar architecture work.
core_features: Adaptation to different lunar geological regions
capabilities.maturity: CSA announced $499,647 for HYDRO+ prototyping on December 13, 2023. CSMC still identifies HYDRO+ in its June 2026 lunar resource study; neither source establishes completed qualification or a deployed processing system.

capabilities.name: Time and Impedance Multi-Sensor Imaging
capabilities.summary: TIMS is a proposed low-power, portable multi-sensor imaging system for geotechnical surveying, field-medical imaging and manufacturing inspection. NRC IRAP funded validation work in 2022-2023; the grant description establishes the concept and intended uses, rather than completed validation.
capabilities.maturity: NRC IRAP agreement 994139 provided $75,000 for concept-validation work from August 15, 2022 to June 30, 2023. Its disclosed objective is validation; it does not report a completed validation result or clinical qualification.

capabilities.name: LEUNR Micro-Nuclear Reactor
capabilities.summary: LEUNR is CSMC's former microreactor concept, retired in the September 9, 2026 launch of POLAR-1, ORCA-1 and JAY-1. It remains relevant as the named subject of earlier development awards; historical project specifications and readiness targets should not be transferred automatically to the new platforms.
core_features: Representative unfuelled analogue testing under CSA agreement 25STDPX13
defence_applications: Research and development for space nuclear power
capabilities.maturity: CSA agreement 25STDPX13 sought to move LEUNR from TRL 4/5 conceptual design toward TRL 6 detailed design by August 31, 2027. CSMC retired the concept in September 2026; this target is historical, not demonstrated readiness of a successor.
capabilities.commercial_availability: Retired concept; the new platform launch does not establish delivery of a commercial LEUNR reactor.

capabilities.name: QASM Quantum Atomic Subsurface Mapper
capabilities.summary: QASM is a proposed quantum-gravimetry sensor for subsurface resource characterization from Earth orbit and other planetary bodies. CSMC's November 2025 Luxembourg contract announcement describes development and a future laboratory-to-field testing sequence, not an operational orbital sensor.
capabilities.maturity: The November 24, 2025 company contract announcement scheduled early laboratory demonstrations for 2026, followed by field testing and validation and a possible later space demonstration. The release reports planned stages; completion has not been established by the reviewed sources.

capabilities.name: ORCA-1 Research Reactor
capabilities.summary: CSMC describes ORCA-1 as a research reactor platform for technology testing, practical training and nuclear workforce development. Its intended users include researchers, students, regulators, operators and industry partners. The announcement establishes a development offering, not an operating training facility.
core_features: Intended hands-on nuclear training and operational experience
Research and testing platform for nuclear technology development
capabilities.maturity: Introduced in September 2026. The inspected company materials provide intended functions but no demonstrated readiness level or commissioning milestone.

capabilities.name: Archer Tactical Troposcatter
capabilities.summary: Deliver secure, high-bandwidth beyond-line-of-sight communications without satellite or fixed infrastructure using a rapidly deployable tactical troposcatter terminal. A June 2026 company-reported FMV evaluation sustained a frequency-diverse 75-kilometre link, integrated with a Swedish Armed Forces mobile network node, and used a two-person, under-20-minute fielding process.
core_features: Toolless setup and automatic antenna alignment
Direct integration with a Swedish Armed Forces mobile network node
Two-person fielding reported in under 20 minutes
defence_applications: Communications in satellite-denied or degraded environments
Expeditionary operations in deserts, mountains and polar regions
Interoperable mobile-network-node backhaul during field evaluation

capabilities.name: SAMS Sensor and Cyber Data Fusion Platform
capabilities.summary: Development-stage platform intended to combine sensor and cyber data into a common operational picture for threat assessment, warning, system-health monitoring and distributed mission-system resilience.
capabilities.capability_type: Development-stage sensor and cyber fusion platform

capabilities.name: Hunter Tactical SATCOM Terminals
capabilities.summary: Deployable tactical satellite-terminal family spanning sub-25-pound ULV and FA-100, FA-180, FA-240 and FA-370 flyaway configurations for X, C, Ku and Ka-band links. Marconi and ST Engineering iDirect describe GEO and MEO access plus an evolution path toward LEO; public records do not establish Telesat Lightspeed compatibility, certification, ESCP-P selection or Canadian Armed Forces delivery.
capabilities.capability_type: Deployable tactical satellite communications terminal family
core_features: ULV plus FA-100, FA-180, FA-240 and FA-370 configurations
Variant-specific setup: ULV under five minutes; FA-100, FA-180 and FA-240 under ten minutes; FA-370 under thirty minutes
Configuration-dependent X, C, Ku and Ka-band operation
FA-180 1.8 metre eight-petal flyaway antenna with quick-release feeds and optional three-axis motorization
Integration path with ST Engineering iDirect modem and network-management technology
defence_applications: Configuration-specific government and commercial satellite-network access
capabilities.maturity: The predecessor tactical-communications business supplied deployable terminals under Mercury Global, for which DND reports certification and full-operational-capability milestones. Public records do not identify which current Hunter variants were fielded, Marconi's present support responsibility, or a Hunter ESCP-P selection.
capabilities.commercial_availability: Marconi currently markets ULV and FA-100, FA-180, FA-240 and FA-370 configurations. A detailed May 2026 public sheet is available for FA-180; configuration, network certification, delivery schedule and support terms require direct verification.

capabilities.name: Orion Tactical Radio Systems
capabilities.summary: Provide high-throughput, resilient software-defined tactical networking across air, land and maritime operations, including mobile ad hoc networking, long-haul links and backhaul for human-machine teams.
core_features: X602, X604, X610 and X650 variants
defence_applications: Air, land and maritime data transport

organizations.name: MetOcean Telematics
organizations.description: Dartmouth designer and manufacturer of satellite-connected oceanographic, tracking, search-and-rescue and defence or security telemetry systems, including drifting buoys, acoustic profiling floats, beacons and Iridium communications hardware and services.

capabilities.name: Satellite-connected drifting and search-and-rescue buoys
capabilities.summary: Collect position, sea-surface temperature and drift data through iSLDMB and environmental drifter products, then return observations over Iridium for search and rescue, spill response and ocean monitoring.
capabilities.capability_type: Drifting buoy, datum marker and ocean-tracking systems
core_features: NATO A-size iSLDMB with GPS, sea-surface temperature and bidirectional Iridium telemetry
Aircraft or ship deployment for search-and-rescue datum marking
Vendor-listed iSLDMB endurance up to about 15 days depending reporting frequency
iSPHERE, iSVP and research drifter variants for environmental monitoring
Current USCG iSLDMB call orders under a five-year BPA
capabilities.maturity: USAspending records three 2026 USCG iSLDMB calls; the Brazilian Navy records maintenance of two owned units; and peer-reviewed researchers report twelve MetOcean surface drifters operating at least 68 days. These sources do not establish delivery acceptance for the 2026 calls.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MetOcean and Iridium list iSLDMB as a current product, and USCG call orders establish current commercial procurement. Public unit pricing, order quantities and standard lead time are not disclosed.

capabilities.name: NiKA autonomous acoustic profiling float
capabilities.summary: Collect acoustic and environmental data through an autonomous profiling float, then return processed mission and position data over Iridium Certus 100 after the float surfaces.
capabilities.capability_type: Autonomous acoustic subsea surveillance and profiling float
core_features: Hydrophone-equipped profiling cycle to a vendor-rated 1,000 metres
Vendor-listed 10 Hz to 2.4 kHz hydrophone range
Acoustic and position data returned by Certus 100 after surfacing
capabilities.maturity: CanadaBuys records a CAD 1.029 million DND NiKA/PAMS award, while FLANQ independently lists a German integration and support relationship. Neither source publishes delivered quantity, acceptance results or measured operational performance.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MetOcean markets NiKA and FLANQ lists support in Germany; the exact production configuration, lead time, security accreditation and contract-delivery status require verification.

capabilities.name: MASS maritime acoustic scoring and simulation system
capabilities.summary: Deploy a portable maritime range system that uses acoustic sensor buoys and platform position data to calculate and display live-fire water-impact locations for training and scoring.
capabilities.capability_type: Deployable maritime live-fire scoring and training system
core_features: Six acoustic sensor buoys for impact-event triangulation
GPS and radio position inputs for buoys and firing platforms
Portable ship-deployable and recoverable system architecture
Vendor-listed radio line of sight of at least 20 kilometres
Vendor-listed operating duration of about 72 hours
capabilities.maturity: UK Contracts Finder records a GBP 990,000 Ministry of Defence award for a Mobile Acoustic Scoring System, and MetOcean identifies the product as MASS and intended customer as the Royal Navy. The sources do not establish commissioning, acceptance, measured performance or operational use.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MetOcean maintains a current MASS product page; public pricing, standard configuration, training package, certification scope and delivery lead time are not disclosed.

capabilities.name: PABLO acoustic profiling float
capabilities.summary: Profile underwater sound at programmed depths to support environmental soundscape and marine-noise monitoring, processing observations onboard and transmitting results by Iridium after resurfacing.
core_features: Programmable profiling and acoustic sampling to a vendor-rated 1,000 metres
Acoustic measurements at selected depths during ascent
Onboard processing of acoustic parameters and spectra
capabilities.maturity: Petrobras and a peer-reviewed 2024 paper document PABLO use in the Santos Basin monitoring program; 234 profilers were launched and 226 returned data during the 2015-2021 first cycle. This is environmental deployment evidence, not defence validation.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MetOcean maintains a public PABLO product page, but current unit pricing, production lead time, supported payload options and standard mission package are not disclosed.

capabilities.name: Satellite IoT telemetry and remote tracking
capabilities.summary: Integrate remote sensors, vessels and assets through Iridium short-burst and Certus terminals, subscriptions, monitoring software and customer-side data workflows.
capabilities.capability_type: Iridium-connected telemetry terminals, tracking hardware and data services
core_features: STREAM 200, 210 and 211 modules using Iridium 9603N with RS-232 or UART interfaces
STREAM+ Certus 100 terminal with vendor-listed 22 kbps uplink and 88 kbps downlink bearer rates
JSON serial API, RS-232, RS-485, PPP and FTPS integration workflows
Customer-side software, antenna, satellite subscription and routing dependencies
Iridium value-added-reseller airtime, integration and support
capabilities.maturity: Iridium names MetOcean as a value-added reseller and reports MetOcean support for Canadian Coast Guard VesseLINK 700 integration. The Thales terminal is third-party hardware, not a MetOcean-manufactured product.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MetOcean offers STREAM and STREAM+ ordering plus airtime and support; application performance depends on the selected bearer, antenna, subscription and customer integration.

organizations.name: OSCPS Motion Sensing
organizations.description: OSCP is a Montréal inertial-sensing company developing MEMS and photonic gyroscope-based measurement units and NavigationGate, a processing platform that combines an OSCP IMU with GNSS and external aiding for navigation when satellite signals are degraded or unavailable.

capabilities.name: MK2 photonic and MEMS inertial measurement units
capabilities.summary: OSCP's MK2 family spans a shipping tactical MEMS unit, a hybrid photonic-and-MEMS unit and an early-access navigation-grade photonic unit for measuring motion and attitude where platform navigation cannot rely on satellite positioning alone.
capabilities.capability_type: Photonic and MEMS inertial measurement units
core_features: MK2M2 tactical MEMS inertial measurement unit with RS-422 and CAN-FD interfaces
MK2E2 hybrid architecture using an optical gyroscope on the z-axis with MEMS sensing on other axes
MK2Z early-access navigation-grade photonic gyroscope architecture
Published raw and AHRS data frames for embedded integration
defence_applications: Ground, air, marine and robotic system integration
capabilities.maturity: OSCP says MK2 tactical units are shipping, MK2E2 specifications are preliminary and MK2Z remains prototype or early-access; public evidence does not establish one maturity level across the family.
capabilities.commercial_availability: MK2M2 and MK2E2 are presented through OSCP product channels; MK2Z is presented as early-access or prototype. Pricing, volume capacity, lead time and accepted deployments require direct confirmation.

capabilities.name: NavigationGate inertial navigation system
capabilities.summary: NavigationGate is an inertial-navigation processing unit that pairs an OSCP IMU with onboard sensor fusion, dual-antenna RTK-compatible GNSS and optional external aiding to output continuous position, velocity and attitude when satellite availability changes.
core_features: OSCP Kalman-filter sensor fusion on an embedded Cortex-M7 processor
Onboard dual-antenna RTK-compatible GNSS with external GNSS support
Aiding inputs for odometry, airspeed and heading
RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, USB-C, CAN 2.0B, CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, UART and GPIO interfaces
MicroSD logging, synchronization and one-pulse-per-second support
75.5 by 58.5 by 30 millimetre enclosure with a separate OEM-board option
defence_applications: Navigation through temporary GNSS outage or interference
Uncrewed ground, air and marine platform navigation
Vehicle position, velocity and attitude estimation
capabilities.maturity: OSCP opened limited first-production-batch preorders on September 1, 2026. No public NavigationGate manual, independent performance report, completed environmental qualification, shipment record or accepted deployment was found.
capabilities.commercial_availability: Limited first-production-batch preorder through OSCP; supported configuration, price, lead time, production volume, export controls and delivery history require direct confirmation.
